newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Vienna, Bank Austria AAA issuer.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Vienna, Bank Austria AAA issuer.

text.p: Standard and Poor's rating agency said on Tuesday it had assigned AAA issuer credit ratings to the city of Vienna and Bank Austria AG.
"The ratings reflect the size, diversity and wealth of Vienna's service-oriented, historically strong financial balances, excellent liquidity and moderate debt levels," S&P said in a statement.
"Although Bank Austria is a significant contingent liability for Vienna, the satisfactory stand-alone credit quality of the bank mitigates concerns over the potential need for assistance."
S&P said that the city of Vienna has a stable economic base, with a diverse service sector accounting for over 70 percent of gross value added.

It said the expansion of businesses using Vienna as their springboard for eastern Europe had not been fast enough to take up the increased supply of labour, sending unemployment up to 7.3 percent in 1995 from 5.8 percent in 1990.
But it added: "The financial peformance of Vienna has been strong."
